pdf_page_count raises an error when the input is not a PDF

```python title="Python"
from xberg import pdf_page_count
from xberg import XbergError

def main() -> None:
    try:
        pdf_bytes = b"this is not a pdf document"
        pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes)
    except XbergError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

main()
```
